Asset type: clean 2D side-scrolling game background composition study, landscape 2560 by 1080 if possible.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: two transparent full-body pixel-art idle sprite samples for a side-scrolling narrative game, one pair only, no animation strip.
Input image 1: Diep Khue identity reference. Input image 2: Luc Thanh Van identity reference. Use the LARGE natural-proportioned character designs, NOT the tiny chibi sprites along the bottom.
Create Khue standing at the LEFT facing RIGHT and Van at the RIGHT facing LEFT, conversational three-quarter side profiles. Entire figures including hair, backpack, satchel and shoe soles must be visible, no overlap, wide transparent gap between them. Exactly two characters, same ground baseline, no props detached from their bodies, no contact shadow, no floor.
Proportions: natural slim Vietnamese high-school teenagers, about 6.5 heads tall, normal-size heads, long limbs, Van slightly shorter. Khue: tousled dark hair, cream-white short-sleeve school shirt, navy trousers, black shoes, worn dark canvas backpack, calm reserved expression. Van: long dark hair loosely tied with muted teal-blue ribbon, rolled-sleeve ivory shirt with navy neck bow, navy knee-length pleated skirt, white socks, black loafers, worn dark satchel, guarded quiet expression.
Style: high-detail PIXEL ART with deliberate crisp square pixel clusters, hard stepped silhouettes, restrained hand-pixelled shading and clear clusters in hair, shirt folds, straps and skirt pleats. Intended actual native visible character height around 192 pixels, enlarged cleanly with nearest-neighbor for delivery. Neither smooth anime illustration nor low-detail 32-pixel RPG chibi. Muted navy/ivory/teal palette and gentle warm edge lighting for a nostalgic sunset coastal school environment. One neutral idle pose per character, arms relaxed, hands readable.
Transparent RGBA background, not checkerboard artwork. No text, labels, framing, watermark, ground, scenery or interface.
references: docs/design/concept/characters/Lục Thanh Vân Character Design Sheet.png
images.role: 192px density target sample, actual crop/grid to be measured.

images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and background-extraction.
Edit target: the supplied two-character sample. Keep BOTH characters' identity, costume, exact standing poses, placement, relative size, and natural 6.5-head body proportions unchanged.
Change two things only:
1) Erase the entire smoky gradient, orange halo, bloom, rim-light aura, ground and ALL background pixels. Every pixel outside the two character silhouettes must have alpha ZERO. Clean hard silhouette edges. No light clouds between characters. No checkerboard drawn into the image.
2) Re-render the TWO FIGURES as unmistakable authentic hand-made 192-pixel-tall game sprites, with visible regular square pixel steps, simplified deliberate color clusters, limited colors, and ZERO soft anti-aliasing. Hair strands become pixel clusters, cloth shading becomes discrete blocky planes. The current source is too fine and illustration-like; make the pixel grid much coarser and consistent across both people. Preserve faces, backpack, blue ribbon, skirt and satchel. Deliver these native 192-pixel figures magnified exactly 4x with nearest-neighbor into a transparent PNG, at a comfortable separation. Entire bodies including shoe soles.
No text, labels, UI, watermark, scenery, backdrop color, glow or shadow. True isolated transparent RGBA pixel-art cutouts only.

Use case: style-transfer. Input is a pair of pixel-art game characters, edit target.
Create a COARSER 128-pixel-native-height density variation of these SAME TWO CHARACTERS. Keep both identities, exact pose, costumes, natural non-chibi body proportions, facing directions, relative height, ground baseline and transparent separation unchanged.
Redraw at a visibly coarser pixel grid with larger square clusters: Khue's entire visible height spans about 128 native pixel rows, Van proportionally shorter. Show the result magnified nearest-neighbor, with consistent hard square steps. Simplify hair highlights, backpack straps, shirt folds and skirt pleats to fit this lower density, preserving recognizable face, ribbon and bags. This must be a newly simplified pixel drawing, not just blur or stretch the input.
Exactly two complete figures, boy left facing right, girl right facing left. Pixel art, no smooth curves, no antialias, no tiny noisy subpixel details, no oversized chibi heads. Transparent RGBA with alpha zero everywhere outside figures, no halo, ground, shadows, text or scenery.
